Package mayhemlib.runner

Class TrajectoryRunner

java.lang.Object
mayhemlib.runner.TrajectoryRunner
public final class TrajectoryRunner extends Object
Runs one trajectory: feedforward + saturated feedback, time dilation, bump detection and bridge recovery, auto unbeach, rough-terrain handling, and event markers. Framework-free (no WPILib command dependencies) so it is fully unit testable; AutoFactory wraps it in commands.

Call start(double) once, then update(double, edu.wpi.first.math.geometry.Pose2d, edu.wpi.first.math.kinematics.ChassisSpeeds, double) every loop with the latest vision-fused pose.

    • withUnbeach

      public TrajectoryRunner withUnbeach(UnbeachConfig config)
      Turns on auto unbeach: while the IMU reports the robot tilted on a pile of fuel, the runner pauses the trajectory, drives toward a point downhill of the tilt, and resumes once flat. Feed pitch and roll through update(double, Pose2d, ChassisSpeeds, double, double, double).

    • update

      public DriveCommand update(double now, edu.wpi.first.math.geometry.Pose2d pose, edu.wpi.first.math.kinematics.ChassisSpeeds fieldSpeeds, double accelG)
      Parameters:
      now - timestamp [s] (e.g. Timer.getFPGATimestamp())
      pose - vision-fused robot pose (alliance-correct field frame)
      fieldSpeeds - measured field-relative speeds (may be null)
      accelG - horizontal acceleration magnitude in g (NaN if not available)

    • update

      public DriveCommand update(double now, edu.wpi.first.math.geometry.Pose2d pose, edu.wpi.first.math.kinematics.ChassisSpeeds fieldSpeeds, double accelG, double pitchDegrees, double rollDegrees)
      Like update(double, Pose2d, ChassisSpeeds, double) with the IMU's pitch and roll for auto unbeach, in degrees and the CTRE Pigeon 2 convention (positive pitch is nose down, positive roll is left side up). NaN disables unbeach detection for this loop.
